# 74166 - 8-bit shift register

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74166.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74166.json)

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 13 | QH = register bit H (last stage) | Serial output of the eighth stage. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 8

Changes on: rising edge of (CLOCK OR CLOCK INHIBIT)

- CLEAR low: all eight flip-flops = 0 at once, overriding all other inputs including the clock
- CLEAR high, SHIFT/LOAD low, clock edge: QA..QH = A..H (synchronous parallel load; serial flow inhibited)
- CLEAR high, SHIFT/LOAD high, clock edge: QA = SERIAL INPUT, QB..QH = QA..QG before the edge
- No clock edge (CLOCK or CLOCK INHIBIT held high, or clock steady): hold
- The clock is a 2-input NOR of CLOCK and CLOCK INHIBIT, clocked on the low-to-high edge of the clock pulse

|---|---|

| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | All inputs buffered to one standard load. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CLEAR | QH | PHL | 23 | 35 |
| CLOCK | QH | PHL | 20 | 30 |
| CLOCK | QH | PLH | 17 | 26 |
